crypto_keylength_justification: Owned MQTT, OTLP HTTPS and Kubernetes HTTPS contexts require TLS1.2+, authenticated certificates and exact verified-chain RSA2048/EC224/DSA2048+224 minima, including trust roots; configured client chains are checked. The documented command-local GitHub CLI/Go release profile rejects smaller keys. Plaintext local protocols require isolation. https://github.com/4alvit/mqtt-observability-opentelemetry/blob/main/SECURITY.md
crypto_working_justification: Supported Python/OpenSSL contexts use current TLS1.2+ policy with 128-bit-or-stronger symmetric encryption and ephemeral key exchange; custom legacy algorithm overrides are not used. The separate GitHub CLI/Go release profile documents its ephemeral exchange and strict certificate-key setting. https://github.com/4alvit/mqtt-observability-opentelemetry/blob/main/SECURITY.md
